metric: instrumental stickiness (figure axis units not printed); lower only for goal of separated grains
same_initial_state: within each variety: 10 g from same commercial variety, same final cooking ratio, same 30 min steam procedure
formula: washes * approx 80 mL, washes * approx 20 s; excludes draining/filling
statistical_result: washing main effect not significant for hardness or stickiness; rice variety × washing treatment interaction for stickiness p<0.01; no pairwise significance or equivalence asserted
limitations: approximate graph values only; no invented error bars
not food safety or taste ranking

separate_cooked_rice_study.intervention: hot-water wash AFTER cooking; distinct from F1 raw washes
separate_cooked_rice_study.limits: Do not mix these values or units with Figure 1 of F1; association with amylose is not a single-factor causal guarantee.
